name: Algebraic Parity Substitution
description: Replaced the explicit structural description of a triangle ("three edges, exactly three unique vertices") with an equivalent algebraic condition ("three edges, all vertex degrees are even"). I expect this to defeat the survivors because it breaks the surface-level pattern match to triangle-finding; unless the model explicitly deduces that three edges with even degrees must form a triangle, it will likely fall back to a naive O(M^3) brute-force search for three edges satisfying the parity condition, which will fail the time limit.
